HIGH — Strong **CYP3A4** inhibitors (Clarithromycin, Ketoconazole) drastically spike tamsulosin levels.
BENEFICIAL — Oral Iron (Ferrous sulfate). Vitamin C converts ferric iron (Fe3+) to ferrous iron (Fe2+), significantly boosting gut absorption.
HIGH — Amphetamines (Dexamphetamine). Because high-dose Vitamin C intensely acidifies the urine, it traps amphetamines in the urine and forces their rapid excretion, ruining their clinical effect.

CRITICAL — Calcium chelates levothyroxine, iron, fluoroquinolones, tetracyclines, and bisphosphonates; separate doses by at least 2-4 hours, and keep bisphosphonates separate per their product directions.
HIGH — Thiazide diuretics (HCTZ) reduce calcium excretion in the kidneys, massively increasing the risk of hypercalcemia.

CRITICAL — Zinc. Massive doses of oral Zinc induce proteins in the gut that trap Copper and poop it out. The #1 cause of Copper deficiency on the ward is a doctor prescribing high-dose Zinc for a bed-sore for 6 months.

CRITICAL — Methotrexate. Folate replaces the exact compound Methotrexate is trying to starve the body of. If taken on the *same day*, the Folate will cancel out the Methotrexate, causing a severe arthritis flare. Must be staggered.
HIGH — Phenytoin and Barbiturates lower folate levels, and paradoxically, giving folate can lower Phenytoin levels, risking seizures.
HIGH — Lithium (Additive hypothyroid effect).
CRITICAL — Calcium, Antacids, Milk, Tea, Coffee. These instantly bind iron in the gut, dropping absorption to near ZERO. Separate by 2-4 hours.
CRITICAL — Doxycycline, Ciprofloxacin, Thyroxine, Levodopa. Iron binds to these drugs and destroys their absorption. Separate strictly by 2-4 hours.
BENEFICIAL — Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) drastically acidifies the stomach and keeps iron in the absorbable Fe2+ state, boosting absorption by 30%.
CRITICAL — Binds to Tetracyclines (Doxycycline) and Fluoroquinolones (Ciprofloxacin) in the gut, completely destroying their antibiotic absorption. Separate by 4 hours.
CRITICAL — Calcium Channel Blockers (Nifedipine, Amlodipine). Combining IV Magnesium with high-dose CCBs causes profound, refractory hypotension and neuromuscular blockade.
HIGH — Non-depolarizing muscle relaxants (Rocuronium). Mag sulfate massively prolongs surgical paralysis.
HIGH — Niacin combined with Statins exponentially increases the risk of rhabdomyolysis.
CRITICAL — ACEi, ARBs, Spironolactone, Amiloride, NSAIDs, Tacrolimus. Co-administration drastically reduces renal K+ excretion, leading to massive hyperkalemia.
CRITICAL — Isoniazid (INH) and Penicillamine actively deplete the body of B6, directly causing seizures and nerve death. You must replace it.

HIGH — Levodopa. Pyridoxine accelerates the peripheral breakdown of Levodopa, stopping it from reaching the brain and ruining Parkinson's control (This interaction is largely bypassed by modern combo pills like Madopar, which contain Benserazide).

HIGH — Antagonises the effect of all antihypertensives and diuretics.
NONE — Safe to combine with all standard ward medications.
CRITICAL — Isotretinoin/Acitretin. These are Vitamin A derivatives. Adding Vitamin A supplements causes instant, severe systemic toxicity and intracranial hypertension.
HIGH — Orlistat blocks absorption (fat-soluble).

HIGH — Metformin, PPIs (Pantoprazole), and Colchicine physically block the absorption of oral B12 in the terminal ileum. Patients on long-term Metformin/PPIs frequently become deficient and require IM replacement.
HIGH — Orlistat and Bile Acid Sequestrants block the absorption of all fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K). Separate doses by 2-4 hours.
MODERATE — Phenytoin and Carbamazepine accelerate Vitamin D metabolism, increasing the dose requirement.
CRITICAL — Warfarin, DOACs, Aspirin. High-dose Vitamin E acts as a blood thinner and will synergistically increase the risk of fatal hemorrhage.
CRITICAL — Warfarin. Vitamin K directly antagonises it.
HIGH — Bile acid sequestrants (Cholestyramine) and Orlistat block fat-soluble vitamin absorption in the gut. Avoid giving PO Vitamin K with them.
CRITICAL — Binds and destroys the absorption of Tetracyclines (Doxycycline) and Fluoroquinolones (Ciprofloxacin). Separate by 4 hours.
CRITICAL — ACEi + Diuretic + NSAID (Ibuprofen/Naproxen). This combination guarantees acute renal failure by destroying both afferent and efferent glomerular blood flow.
HIGH — Potassium-sparing diuretics (Spironolactone, Eplerenone), K+ supplements (Severe hyperkalemia).
HIGH — Lithium (ACE inhibitors reduce renal clearance of lithium, leading to lithium toxicity).

CRITICAL — Metabolised extensively by **CYP3A4**. Strong inhibitors (Clarithromycin, Erythromycin, Itraconazole, Ketoconazole, Grapefruit juice) massively increase Simvastatin levels, precipitating rhabdomyolysis and acute renal failure. Concurrent use is contraindicated.
HIGH — Gemfibrozil (Fibrate) blocks statin glucuronidation and uptake, drastically increasing blood levels. Contraindicated combo.
HIGH — Moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (Amiodarone, Diltiazem, Verapamil, Amlodipine). Limit Simvastatin dose to max 20 mg/day (or 10 mg/day with Amiodarone/Verapamil/Diltiazem) to prevent myopathy.
